statement.text:
Let Γg be the fundamental group of a closed surface of genus g ⩾ 2. For
each finite system S of generators of Γg , let βS (n) denote the number of elements
of Γg which can be written   p   as products of at most n elements of S ∪ S −1 , and let
                             n
ω(Γg , S) = lim supn→∞ βS (n) be the growth rate of the sequence (βS (n))n⩾0 .
Compute the infimum ω(Γg ) of the ω(Γg , S) over all finite sets of generators of Γg .
    It is easy to see that, for a free group Fk of rank k ⩾ 2, the corresponding infimum
is ω(Fk ) = 2k − 1 (M. Gromov, Structures métriques pour les variétés riemanniennes,
Cedic/F. Nathan, Paris, 1981, Ex. 5.13). As any generating set of Γg contains a subset
of 2g − 1 elements generating a subgroup of infinite index in Γg with abelianization
Z2g−1 , hence a subgroup which is free of rank 2g − 1, it follows that ω(Γg ) ⩾ 4g − 3.
                                                                           P. de la Harpe
